name: "Rainbow" Soba Noodle Bowl with Mixed Veggies, Cashews & Peanut Sauce (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses 4 large and 4 mini food storage containers.

Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, add soba noodles and cook until tender, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Drain and rinse under cold water to cool, then set aside.
Meanwhile, divide peanut sauce between the mini containers, cover, and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onion (scallion)
1 red bell pepper
1 English cucumber
½ small head red cabbage

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place on a large plate.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the plate with the green onion, keeping them separate.
Trim and cut cucumber into thin matchsticks. Add to the plate.
Peel, trim, and cut carrots into thin matchsticks. Add to the plate.
Trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the plate.
Roughly chop cashews. Add to the plate.

Divide cooled noodles between the large containers, then top with veggies and cashews. Add peanut sauce, then cover and refrigerate until ready to eat. Drizzle noodles and veggies with sauce and enjoy!
